Alias.script:
local cmd = matches[2] local args = matches[3]
cpc:handleCommand(cmd,args)

Script.name: CPC_Main_Script
Script.script:
cpc = cpc or {} -- 0.0.0 is localbuild version, will get replaced by github actions when tagging cpc.version = "0.0.0" cpc.onlinePath = "https://github.com/techjoec/cpc/releases/latest/download/" cpc.onlineVersionFile = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techjoec/cpc/main/versions.lua" -- the folder that holds the profile folders: what every profile on this machine shares cpc.sharedDir = getMudletHomeDir():match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$") or getMudletHomeDir() cpc.debug = cpc.debug or false cpc.localEcho = cpc.localEcho or true -- true: a #BID or #TELL target reaches at most one profile (see cpc:isTarget) cpc.strictTargets = cpc.strictTargets or false -- "notify": at load, say when a newer release exists, with a link to it; "on": install it -- (package installs only; a module from a git clone is told to pull); "off": never look -- online. #CPC UPDATE installs the latest on request whatever the setting. cpc.autoUpdate = cpc.autoUpdate or "notify" -- hours between online checks, shared by every profile on this machine: the first profile to -- load after that long fetches the version list, the others read what it fetched. 0: every load cpc.checkInterval = cpc.checkInterval or 24 cpc.releasePage = "https://github.com/techjoec/cpc/releases/tag/" -- settings files, kept across package updates, each returning a table of the fields above, -- e.g. return { autoUpdate = "off", strictTargets = true }: one for every profile on this -- machine, cpc-settings.lua in the folder that holds the profile folders, then the profile's -- own <profile>/cpc-settings.lua over it cpc.globalSettingsFile = cpc.sharedDir .. "/cpc-settings.lua" cpc.settingsFile = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/cpc-settings.lua" for _, path in ipairs({ cpc.globalSettingsFile, cpc.settingsFile }) do local f = io.open(path, "r") if f then f:close() local ok, t = pcall(dofile, path) if ok and type(t) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(t) do cpc[k] = v end else cecho("<orange>CPC: could not read " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(t) .. "\n") end end end
-- the settings #CPC CONFIG shows and sets, in this order; a bool takes on/off/true/false/yes/no cpc.settingsSpec = { { "autoUpdate", choices = { "notify", "on", "off" }, help = "at load: notify of a newer release, install it, or never look online" }, { "checkInterval", number = true, help = "hours between online checks, shared by every profile; 0 checks at every load" }, { "strictTargets", bool = true, help = "a #BID/#TELL target reaches at most one profile" }, { "localEcho", bool = true, help = "echo CPC's own notices in this profile" }, { "debug", bool = true, help = "log what CPC does" }, } cpc.thisProfileName = getProfileName():lower() cpc.downloadPath = cpc.sharedDir .. "/cpc downloads/" cpc.checkStamp = cpc.downloadPath .. "last-check" cpc.downloading = false cpc.loadedAs = "unknown"
function cpc:log(text) if cpc.debug==true then debugc("CPC:"..text) end end
function cpc:syntax(text) cecho("<orange>"..text) end
function cpc:echo(text) if cpc.localEcho==true then cecho("<cyan>"..text) print() end end
function cpc:showVersion() local vline = cpc:checkVersion() cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-50s: %s %s\n","Cross Profile Communication",cpc.version,vline)) end
function cpc:showHelp() cecho("<cyan>Cross Profile Communication:\n") cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#HELP"),"Show Helpfile(s)")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#VERSION"),"Show version(s)")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#CPC UPDATE"),"Upgrade the package")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#CPC CONFIG [<setting> <value>]"),"Show the settings, or set one for every profile")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#ALL <arguments>"),"Send command to all profiles")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#DO <arguments>"),"Send command to all other profiles")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#DO party report"),"Ex: tell all other profiles to execute 'party report'")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#BID <profile> <arguments>"),"Send command to one character (immediate execution)")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#BID gandalf say hello"),"Ex: tell Gandalf to execute 'say hello'"))
cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#ECHO <text>"),"Show something in all terminals")) cecho(string.format("<cyan>%-30s- %s\n",string.format(" %s","#TELL <profile>"),"Show something in one particular terminal")) cecho("<cyan>---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n") print() end
function cpc:handleCommand(cmd,args)
cpc:log("CPC: Handle command") cpc:log("cmd:'"..cmd.."'") cpc:log("args:'"..args.."'") cmd = string.lower(cmd)
if (cmd=="help") then cpc:showHelp() elseif (cmd=="version") then cpc:showVersion() elseif (cmd=="all") then if args ~= "" then -- Send event to all profiles, including self raiseGlobalEvent("cpc_all",args) raiseEvent("cpc_all",args) else cpc:syntax("#ALL must be called with an argument, e.g. '#ALL say hi'") end elseif (cmd=="do") then -- Only send event to other profiles, otherwise same as #ALL if args ~= "" then raiseGlobalEvent("cpc_all",args) else cpc:syntax("#DO must be called with an argument, e.g. '#DO say hi''") end elseif (cmd=="echo") then if args ~= "" then -- Send event to all profiles, including self raiseGlobalEvent("cpc_echo",args) raiseEvent("cpc_echo",args) else cpc:syntax("#ECHO must be called with an argument, e.g. '#ECHO Under attack!'") end elseif (cmd=="tell") then if args ~= "" then -- Send event to all profiles, including self raiseGlobalEvent("cpc_tell",args) raiseEvent("cpc_tell",args) else cpc:syntax("#TELL must be called with arguments, e.g. '#TELL Gandalf Help me!'") end elseif (cmd=="bid") then raiseGlobalEvent("cpc_bid",args) raiseEvent("cpc_bid",args) elseif (cmd=="cpc") and (args:lower()=="update") then cpc:downloadLatestVersion() elseif (cmd=="cpc") and args:lower():match("^config") then cpc:configCommand(args:match("^%S+%s*(.*)$")) else cecho("<orange>Command '".. string.upper(cmd) .. " ".. string.upper(args) .. "' not supported!\n") end end
-- a value typed for a setting, or nil and why not function cpc:parseSetting(spec, raw) local v = (raw or ""):lower() if spec.number then local n = tonumber(v) if n and n >= 0 then return n end return nil, "a number of hours, 0 or more" end if spec.bool then if v == "on" or v == "true" or v == "yes" or v == "1" then return true end if v == "off" or v == "false" or v == "no" or v == "0" then return false end return nil, "on or off" end for _, c in ipairs(spec.choices) do if v == c then return c end end return nil, table.concat(spec.choices, ", ") end
-- the table a settings file holds, or an empty one function cpc:readSettingsFile(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return {} end f:close() local ok, t = pcall(dofile, path) return (ok and type(t) == "table") and t or {} end
-- write a settings file: the known settings in order, then anything else the file already held function cpc:writeSettingsFile(path, t) local known, lines = {}, {} local function lit(v) if type(v) == "string" then return string.format("%q", v) end return tostring(v) end for _, spec in ipairs(cpc.settingsSpec) do known[spec[1]] = true if t[spec[1]] ~= nil then lines[#lines + 1] = " " .. spec[1] .. " = " .. lit(t[spec[1]]) .. "," end end for k, v in pairs(t) do if not known[k] and type(k) == "string" then lines[#lines + 1] = " " .. k .. " = " .. lit(v) .. "," end end local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then return nil, err end f:write("return {\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n}\n") f:close() return true end
-- #CPC CONFIG: the settings and how to set each; #CPC CONFIG <setting> <value>: set one in the -- global settings file (every profile on this machine) and in this profile now function cpc:configCommand(rest) local key, value = (rest or ""):match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)%s*$") if key and key ~= "" then local spec for _, sp in ipairs(cpc.settingsSpec) do if sp[1]:lower() == key:lower() then spec = sp end end if not spec then local names = {} for _, sp in ipairs(cpc.settingsSpec) do names[#names + 1] = sp[1] end cecho("<orange>CPC: no setting '" .. key .. "'; the settings are " .. table.concat(names, ", ") .. "\n") return end local v, want = cpc:parseSetting(spec, value) if v == nil then cecho("<orange>CPC: " .. spec[1] .. " takes " .. want .. "\n") return end local t = cpc:readSettingsFile(cpc.globalSettingsFile) t[spec[1]] = v local ok, err = cpc:writeSettingsFile(cpc.globalSettingsFile, t) if not ok then cecho("<orange>CPC: could not write " .. cpc.globalSettingsFile .. ": " .. tostring(err) .. "\n") return end cpc[spec[1]] = v cecho("<cyan>CPC: " .. spec[1] .. " = " .. tostring(v) .. " for every profile; open profiles pick it up at their next load") if spec[1] == "autoUpdate" then cecho("<cyan> (the check at load follows it from then on)") end cecho("\n<cyan>Cfg: " .. cpc.globalSettingsFile .. "\n") return end local global = cpc:readSettingsFile(cpc.globalSettingsFile) local own = cpc:readSettingsFile(cpc.settingsFile) cecho("<cyan>Cross Profile Communication settings:\n") for _, spec in ipairs(cpc.settingsSpec) do local name = spec[1] local from = own[name] ~= nil and "this profile's file" or global[name] ~= nil and "global file" or "default" local takes = spec.bool and "on|off" or spec.number and "hours" or table.concat(spec.choices, "|") cecho(string.format("<cyan> %-14s = %-7s <grey>(%s) %s\n", name, tostring(cpc[name]), from, spec.help)) cecho(string.format("<cyan> %-14s <yellow>#CPC CONFIG %s <%s>\n", "", name, takes)) end cecho("<cyan>Cfg: " .. cpc.globalSettingsFile .. "\n") if own and next(own) then cecho("<cyan>Cfg (this profile, applied over it): " .. cpc.settingsFile .. "\n") end end
function cpc:parseProfileAndArgs(arg) local targetProfile, remainder
-- Try double quotes targetProfile, remainder = arg:match('^"([^"]+)"%s*(.*)$') if targetProfile then return targetProfile, remainder end
-- Try single quotes targetProfile, remainder = arg:match("^'([^']+)'%s*(.*)$") if targetProfile then return targetProfile, remainder end
-- Fall back to space-separated (for backward compatibility) targetProfile, remainder = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") return targetProfile or "", remainder or "" end
function cpc:onCmdAll(event,arg,profile) cpc:log("onCmdAll()") --cpc:log("Event: " .. event) cpc:log("Arg : " .. arg) -- If the event is not raised with raiseGlobalEvent() profile will be 'nil' --echo("Profile: " .. (profile or "Local") .. "\n")
cpc:echo((profile or "Local") .. " asked everyone to '" .. arg.."'") expandAlias(arg) end
-- Does a #BID or #TELL target name this profile? With cpc.strictTargets off (the default) a -- target is matched as a part of the profile name, so "mage" reaches every open Mage-* -- profile. With it on, a target reaches at most one profile: an exact name (case aside), or -- else a part of a name that exactly one open profile contains. Several matches send nothing -- and the sender lists them; no match is reported in the sender; the other profiles stay -- silent (the sender is the local raiseEvent half, which arrives with profile == "Local"). function cpc:isTarget(target, isSender) target = (target or ""):lower() if not cpc.strictTargets then return cpc.thisProfileName:find(target, 1, true) ~= nil end if target == "" then return false end local open = {} for name, info in pairs(getProfiles()) do if info.loaded then open[#open + 1] = name end end for _, name in ipairs(open) do if name:lower() == target then return cpc.thisProfileName == target end end local matches = {} for _, name in ipairs(open) do if name:lower():find(target, 1, true) then matches[#matches + 1] = name end end if #matches == 1 then return matches[1]:lower() == cpc.thisProfileName end if isSender then if #matches == 0 then cecho("<orange>CPC: no open profile matches '" .. target .. "'\n") else table.sort(matches) cecho("<orange>CPC: '" .. target .. "' matches " .. #matches .. " open profiles (" .. table.concat(matches, ", ") .. "); nothing sent, use more of the name\n") end end return false end
function cpc:onBidEvent(event,arg,profile) local words = {} local targetProfile local cmd targetProfile, cmd = cpc:parseProfileAndArgs(arg)
-- strip leading and trailing whitespace cmd = string.gsub(cmd, '^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')
--cpc:log("Tell " .. words[1] .. " to execute '" .. cmd.."'") cpc:log("Tell <" .. targetProfile .. "> to execute '" .. cmd.."'")
if profile == nil then profile = "Local" end if cpc:isTarget(targetProfile, profile == "Local") then cpc:echo("<cyan>" .. profile .. " bade me execute '" .. cmd .. "'") expandAlias(cmd) end end
function cpc:onEchoEvent(event,args,profile) --print("echo") cecho("<cyan>"..args) print() end
function cpc:onFileDownloaded(event, ...) --print("onFileDownloaded") if event == "sysDownloadDone" and cpc.downloading then --print("check what type of file") local file = arg[1] --display(file) --display(arg) if string.ends(file,"/versions.lua") then --print("Versions file downloaded from github") cpc.downloading=false cpc:onVersionsFetched() elseif string.ends(file,"/cpc.xml") then --print("DEPRECATED: New version of CPC downloaded...") cpc.downloading=false --cpc:update_version() elseif string.ends(file,"/cpc.mpackage") then --print("New version of CPC downloaded...") cpc.downloading=false cpc:update_version() end
end end
function cpc:onModuleOrPackageLoaded(event,...) --print("module loaded") --print("check if module or package") --display(event) --display(arg) if (event=="sysInstallPackage") and (arg[1]=="Cross Profile Communication") then cpc.loadedAs="package" elseif (event=="sysInstallModule") and (arg[1]=="cpc") then cpc.loadedAs="module" end
end
function cpc:onTellEvent(event,arg,profile) local words = {} local targetProfile local text targetProfile, text = cpc:parseProfileAndArgs(arg) -- strip leading and trailing whitespace text = string.gsub(text, '^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')
--cpc:log("Tell " .. words[1] .. " to execute '" .. cmd.."'") cpc:log("Tell <" .. targetProfile .. "> to echo '" .. text.."'")
if profile == nil then profile = "Local" end if cpc:isTarget(targetProfile, profile == "Local") then cecho("<cyan>" .. text) print() end end
function cpc:downloadVersionFile() --print("Download the versions file") if not io.exists(cpc.downloadPath) then lfs.mkdir(cpc.downloadPath) end -- stamp first, so profiles loading alongside this one see the check as done local f = io.open(cpc.checkStamp, "w") if f then f:write(tostring(os.time()) .. "\n") f:close() end local filename = "versions.lua" cpc.downloading=true downloadFile(cpc.downloadPath .. filename, cpc.onlineVersionFile) end
-- is an online check due: no list or stamp yet, checkInterval 0, or the stamp older than it function cpc:checkDue() if cpc.checkInterval == 0 then return true end if not io.exists(cpc.downloadPath .. "versions.lua") then return true end local stamped = lfs and lfs.attributes and lfs.attributes(cpc.checkStamp, "modification") return not stamped or os.time() - stamped >= cpc.checkInterval * 3600 end
-- how many releases this copy is behind the fetched list, and the newest one; 0 and this -- version when the list has not been fetched (cpc.autoUpdate "off") or does not know this version function cpc:versionStatus() local path = cpc.downloadPath .. "versions.lua" if not io.exists(path) then return 0, cpc.version end local versions = {} table.load(path, versions) local pos = table.index_of(versions, cpc.version) if not pos or #versions == 0 then return 0, cpc.version end return #versions - pos, versions[#versions] end
function cpc:checkVersion() local behind, latest = cpc:versionStatus() if behind == 0 then return cpc.autoUpdate == "off" and "<orange>(auto update off)" or "" end return "<orange>(" .. behind .. " behind online - " .. latest .. ")\n \t #CPC UPDATE to upgrade" end
-- installed as a package (the mpackage), as opposed to a module from a git clone function cpc:installedAsPackage() if cpc.loadedAs == "package" then return true end if cpc.loadedAs == "module" then return false end return getPackages ~= nil and table.contains(getPackages(), "Cross Profile Communication") end
-- the version list has arrived at load: act on cpc.autoUpdate function cpc:onVersionsFetched() local behind, latest = cpc:versionStatus() if behind == 0 then return end local page = cpc.releasePage .. latest if cpc.autoUpdate == "on" and cpc:installedAsPackage() then cecho("<cyan>CPC " .. cpc.version .. " is " .. behind .. " behind; installing " .. latest .. "\n") cpc:downloadLatestVersion() elseif cpc.autoUpdate == "on" or cpc.autoUpdate == "notify" then cecho("<cyan>CPC " .. cpc.version .. ": release " .. latest .. " is available, ") cechoLink("<yellow>" .. page, "openUrl('" .. page .. "')", "open the release page", true) if cpc.autoUpdate == "on" then cecho("<cyan> (installed as a module: pull the clone to update)\n") else cecho("<cyan> (#CPC UPDATE to install)\n") end end end
function cpc:downloadLatestVersion() print("download new version of cpc") if not io.exists(cpc.downloadPath) then lfs.mkdir(cpc.downloadPath) end local filename = "cpc.mpackage" cpc.downloading=true downloadFile(cpc.downloadPath .. filename, cpc.onlinePath .. filename) end
function cpc:update_version() print("Update the version") --local path = profilePath .. "/map downloads/generic_mapper.xml" --uninstallPackage("cpc") -- remove local instance (module) --uninstallModule("cpc") -- remove local instance (module) cpc:killAllExistingEventHandlers()
uninstallPackage("Cross Profile Communication")
installPackage(cpc.downloadPath .. "cpc.mpackage") --installModule end
function cpc:killAllExistingEventHandlers() if cpc.allEventHandler~=nil then killAnonymousEventHandler(cpc.allEventHandler) end if cpc.bidEventHandler~=nil then killAnonymousEventHandler(cpc.bidEventHandler) end if cpc.echoEventHandler~=nil then killAnonymousEventHandler(cpc.echoEventHandler) end if cpc.tellEventHandler~=nil then killAnonymousEventHandler(cpc.tellEventHandler) end if cpc.downloadFileHandler~=nil then killAnonymousEventHandler(cpc.downloadFileHandler) end if cpc.cpcPackageLoadedHandler~=nil then killAnonymousEventHandler(cpc.cpcPackageLoadedHandler) end if cpc.cpcModuleLoadedHandler~=nil then killAnonymousEventHandler(cpc.cpcModuleLoadedHandler) end end
-- CPC Event handlers cpc.allEventHandler = cpc.allEventHandler or nil cpc.bidEventHandler = cpc.bidEventHandler or nil cpc.echoEventHandler = cpc.echoEventHandler or nil cpc.tellEventHandler = cpc.tellEventHandler or nil cpc.downloadFileHandler = cpc.downloadFileHandler or nil cpc.cpcPackageLoadedHandler = cpc.cpcPackageLoadedHandler or nil cpc.cpcModuleLoadedHandler = cpc.cpcModuleLoadedHandler or nil
cpc:killAllExistingEventHandlers() -- remove existing event handlers before creating new ones
-- setup event handlers cpc.allEventHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("cpc_all","cpc:onCmdAll") cpc.bidEventHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("cpc_bid","cpc:onBidEvent") cpc.echoEventHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("cpc_echo","cpc:onEchoEvent") cpc.tellEventHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("cpc_tell","cpc:onTellEvent") cpc.downloadFileHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone","cpc:onFileDownloaded") cpc.cpcModuleLoadedHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysInstallModule","cpc:onModuleOrPackageLoaded") cpc.cpcPackageLoadedHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysInstallPackage","cpc:onModuleOrPackageLoaded")
if cpc.autoUpdate ~= "off" then if cpc:checkDue() then cpc:downloadVersionFile() else cpc:onVersionsFetched() end end

Script.name: OnCPCEcho
Script.script: function OnCPCEcho(event, args) -- Consider moving handlers to separate scripts... --print("OnCPCEcho") end
